info.title: FEAGI API Documentation
info.description:
FEAGI REST API will help you integrate FEAGI into other applications and provides a 
    programmatic method to interact with 
    FEAGI.

post.description:
This API allows you to browse files from your computer and upload a genome to FEAGI.
The genome must be in the form of a python file.

Enables changes against various Burst Engine parameters.

Sustained stimulation will create a new connectivity rule and connects brain power to across the cortical area.

Important Note: Prior sustained stimulation's will be overwritten when new one is induced. If an x index is omitted
from the list, the prior connections to given area will be removed.

Stimulation needs to be in the following format:

{
"cortical_id": [[2, 0, 0, 20], [5, 0, 0, 10]]
}

post.description:
Configure the weights associated with each fitness criteria.

Important: Total weights has to equal to 1.

Actual game stats will be weighted based on the defined criteria and produce a single fitness value between 0 and 1.
```json
{
    "time_alive": 0.4,
    "max_level_reached": 0.2,
    "score_trying_to_max": 1.0,
    "score_trying_to_min": -1.0,
    "something_custom": 0.4
}
```
